text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear title and thesis in the opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents its position early and follows a recognizable introduction-body-conclusion structure."},{"evidence":"three separate body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"development","description":"It develops the argument in distinct sections rather than keeping ideas all in one block."},{"evidence":"specific article reference to \"half a million miles without a crash\"","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses details from the source article to back up its claims instead of relying only on opinion."},{"evidence":"explains drunk driving, elderly drivers, and injured persons","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It expands each point with examples that show why driverless cars could reduce human error."},{"evidence":"uses transitions like \"With that in mind\" and \"Along with that\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The ideas are linked with signposting that helps the argument move from one point to the next."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of the three reasons","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by summarizing the argument and reinforcing the thesis."}]}
